message:
slimbus: qcom-ngd-ctrl: Bring the NGD up if the DSP is already running

The controller starts the NGD only from a DSP power-up notification (SSR
or PDR). When the DSP boots before the driver loads, as the MSM8226 ADSP
does, no notification follows and the bus never comes up; the driver then
needs a DSP restart. Schedule the bring-up once at probe as well. The
worker waits for the QMI SLIMbus service, so on a stopped DSP it times out
and the later power-up notification brings the NGD up as before.
